title: World Bank — Liberia GREAT digital-ID and digital-government, 2025
description: "Liberia's Ministry of Finance and Development Planning launched the Governance Reform Accountability Transformation (GREAT) project on 20 March 2025 in Monrovia. Funded by the World Bank's ID Credit Program with $30 million (plus an additional $13m for digital infrastructure), GREAT seeks to enroll at least 2 million Liberians for the national digital ID through the NIR." Running to November 2030, it also builds a digital-government ecosystem beginning with nine institutions.
recipient_organisation: GREAT project / Ministry of Finance and Development Planning

title: Orange Telecom Project in Liberia \u2013 Expansion Guarantee
description: MIGA guarantee of $81 million to Orange Cote d'Ivoire Participations (OCIP) covering existing equity investment and future retained earnings for telecom operations and expansion in Orange Liberia Inc., including construction of telecom towers, installation of fiber optic cable, and provision of telecom services and mobile finance services. Risks: Expropriation and War and Civil Disturbance for up to 8 years. Issued September 8, 2023 (FY2024). MIGA's first contract in Liberia since 2016.

title: Escotel Liberia \u2013 Solar Power for Telecom Towers Guarantee
description: MIGA political risk guarantee of $12.06 million to Escotel Mauritius covering its investment in Escotel Liberia Inc., which installs and operates solar-hybrid power systems at ~612 telecom tower sites in Liberia owned/operated by Orange Liberia. Avoids 158,000 tCO2e over the guarantee period. Risks: Transfer Restriction, Expropriation, War and Civil Disturbance for up to 10 years.
